text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Severity 2 - elevated 5xx rate and timeouts observed from inference region us-east-1. Impact: model-store GET timeouts leading to increased inference failures. Alert threshold breached: >8% error-rate sustained for 3m. Paging alpha on-call.

alice.sre: Im jumping on this. Starting a running notes thread in incidents.

ben.prodeng: quick question - any evidence of a deploy or config change?

alice.sre: No recent deploys in the window. Logs point to backend storage latency: numerous "GetObject timeout" entries and increased TCP retransmits. A subset of requests show kv-cache misses which amplify load.

alice.sre: Sample from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:20:03Z ERROR proxy.go:211 req_id=abcd-1234 backend=modestore err="GetObject timeout after 10s"
2026-03-15T10:20:04Z WARN balancer.go:77 batch_delay=120ms reason=ErrTimeout
```

carmen-support: Customer success flagged a handful of enterprise tenants seeing high p95 latency and some 502s. Well need an external status update and customer DMs.

mika-devex: Mitigation idea: enable graceful model-fallback to a quantized variant to reduce model-store reads, and split traffic to another region to reduce pressure on us-east.

alice.sre: Proposed plan: 1) Toggle model-fallback (non-critical traffic) to quantized-variant-1. 2) Traffic split: route 20% to us-west-2. 3) Open vendor escalation with cloud storage for network/storage path investigation.

oncall-rotation-bot: alice.sre is current alpha on-call. ETA to apply mitigations: ~10m.

ben.prodeng: Ill draft the status page copy. Carmen can adjust customer-facing messaging.

carmen-support: Will prep DMs; call out recommended retries and note API keys unaffected.

alice.sre: Applying mitigations now: enabling fallback policy and updating routing rule.

alice.sre: Done. Fallback=graceful-fallback-v2 enabled. Traffic split set us-east=80 us-west-2=20. Observability shows error-rate drop to ~3.2% within first minute.

incident-bot: Automation: fallback toggle has a 30m automatic rollback window unless extended. Monitoring alert configured for error-rate regressions.

mika-devex: Draft status page message suggestion: "We are investigating elevated failures and latency in our US-East inference region. Temporary fallbacks and traffic routing have been applied to reduce customer impact while we work with our storage provider on a root cause."

ben.prodeng: Posting subject: "Investigating elevated latencies/errors in US-East". Carmen, send any customer-specific notes and Ill append.

carmen-support: Add note: enterprise tenants with workspace-level fallbacks applied; recommend clients implement exponential backoff.

alice.sre: Escalated to cloud vendor: ticket CP-2026-0421 created. Details: intermittent GetObject timeouts from peering path starting ~2026-03-15T10:15Z with attached traces, tcpdump, and sample request ids. Requested P1 network/storage engineer.

cloud-liaison: Vendor acknowledged CP-2026-0421. Initial triage ETA: ~30m. They requested our tcpdump and a topology diagram (submitted).

ben.prodeng: Customer DM template for support to use: "Hi [CustomerName],
We are investigating intermittent timeouts and increased latencies for requests from our US-East inference region. Weve applied temporary fallbacks and rerouted a portion of traffic to an alternate region to reduce impact. Please consider increasing client-side retries with exponential backoff. We will update within 60 minutes or sooner.
Thanks,
Redwood Support"

carmen-support: Sending DMs to affected accounts now and logging responses.

alice.sre: Internal exec/status blurb: "Incident: elevated storage/network timeouts in us-east causing ~8% error rate. Mitigations applied: model fallback + 20% traffic to us-west-2, reducing errors to ~3%. Vendor ticket CP-2026-0421 opened. Next steps: vendor packet trace analysis and potential edge scaling. Next update in 30m."

mika-devex: For handoff runbook: include toggles applied, key log ids, vendor ticket link, and exact revert commands.

alice.sre: Handoff snapshot (10:28Z): mitigations - graceful-fallback-v2=ON; routing us-east:80/us-west-2:20; vendor ticket CP-2026-0421 (acknowledged); metrics: error-rate 8.3% peak -> 3.1% now; p95 latency improved 1.8s -> 0.9s. Revert commands:
```bash
# disable fallback
redwoodctl config put inference.fallback.graceful-fallback-v2=false --env=prod
# restore traffic
redwoodctl routing set-split inference us-east=100 us-west-2=0 --env=prod
```
oncall-rotation-bot: alice.sre to hand off at 10:45Z to ben.prodeng. Please confirm.

ben.prodeng: I ACK and will take over monitoring and vendor comms.

incident-bot: Status page updated: "Investigating elevated latencies/errors in US-East. Mitigation in place; some customers may still see intermittent timeouts." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1812

carmen-support: DMs sent to the six affected enterprise workspaces; tracking replies here.

cloud-liaison: Vendor initial update: increased tail latencies observed in their storage API for us-east; investigating a recent routing-tier config change. Vendor ETA for fix: 45-90m, will update in 30m.

alice.sre: Maintaining fallbacks until vendor confirms stabilization. Preparing rollback checklist in case vendor clears us.

mika-devex: Recommend adding a short FAQ to status page: how to mitigate (retry/backoff, change preferred region).

ben.prodeng: Posted FAQ: "If you experience increased latencies or timeouts, implement client-side retries with exponential backoff or configure your workspace to prefer alternate regions. Contact support if you need assistance."

incident-bot: Next scheduled update in 30 minutes or on material change.

carmen-support: First customer reported improved behavior after client retry changes; logging as mitigation evidence.

alice.sre: If errors remain >5% after vendor window, well push further mitigations or escalate. Otherwise prepare staged rollback.

ben.prodeng: Keeping this channel as the single source of truth for incident coordination. Tag any postmortem-worthy notes with :memo: and @ben.prodeng.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff complete at 2026-03-15T10:45Z. Active on-call now ben.prodeng.

incident-bot: Not closing page yet  open until vendor confirms root cause. Last observed error-rate: 3.1% (10:42Z).

alice.sre: Ending active mitigation log for now. Will write a postmortem draft once we have full vendor artifacts.

ben.prodeng: Thanks everyone. Great coordination. :thumbsup:

cloud-liaison: Vendor update (30m): fix rolling through routing tier; see CP-2026-0421#update2. Expect gradual stabilization in 20-40m.

carmen-support: Sending customers the vendor ETA update.

alice.sre: Standing by; will reopen if metrics regress.

ben.prodeng: Closing the live coordination thread but keeping incident open until vendor verifies remediation.
